facts.name: Kathleen H. Roberts
facts.assignment: Circuit profile: one-third of Martin County Court cases and County Election Canvassing Board. Governor vacancy index identifies retirement and marks Appointed; linked letter appoints Daniel Mittleman to Martin County Court. Current service is not confirmed.

contact.contact_note: As published on circuit profile, subject to current-service discrepancy. Fax and courtroom not published in reviewed profile/roster.

chambers_communications.summary: Provide case number and party names when contacting assistant; copy all parties and file material sent to judge.

hearing_scheduling.summary: All hearings through assistant; no online calendar. Send hearing notice to all parties, clerk and judicial office at least five business days ahead; mailing five days before is insufficient. Notify assistant and file/serve cancellations promptly.

proposed_orders.summary: PDF/a or Word, by assistant email or mailed hardcopy; evidence of opposing-party agreement required when agreement asserted. Include all service emails and addressed stamped envelopes for pro se service.

courtesy_copies.summary: For evidentiary proceedings send courtesy legal materials in PDF or Word by assistant email, mail or delivery with reasonable review time. Do not send trial evidence to judge in advance.

remote_appearances.summary: Written motion with sufficient review time required. Zoom details from assistant; evidentiary hearings in person; remote appearances at end of docket.

facts.summary: Published contact and practical county-civil operating instructions retained with current-service qualification. Detailed criminal and landlord-tenant litigation mechanics excluded.

conflicts.subject: Current service
statements: Governor vacancy index marks Appointed; August19 letter appoints Daniel Mittleman to Martin County Court subject to filing qualifying papers.
conflicts.disposition: Preserve both without asserting assumption-of-office date.

gaps: Current-service status and successor contact/procedure record require county reconciliation.
Fax and courtroom not published in reviewed profile/roster.

review_scope.collected: Complete official profile HTML/text/link inventory and original appointment scan/render; prior governor vacancy page reused.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, explicit assignment and recurring scheduling, submissions, appearances and orders; full appointment letter visually reviewed.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal/claim-specific litigation instructions, forms and calendars. Printable procedures link only. Template-example paragraphs not treated as operative requirements.
